expect.description:
It's a Philly thing! This holographic glitter sticker sheet has 9 hand-drawn Philadelphia-inspired stickers: a soft pretzel, a cheesesteak, a Philly-style water ice cup, a Philly candy bar, a highway sign, independence hall, a Fly Eagles Fly wings piece, and more. Peel them off one at a time for laptops, water bottles, notebooks, planners, and phone cases.

Glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl with a holographic glitter finish
Each sticker is die-cut with a white border
Sheet size: 3.06" wide x 4.57" tall

Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

Photo notes: photo 3 shows the stickers laid out separately, and photos 4, 5 and 6 are digital mockups showing a few stickers in use. Glitter sparkle looks different in every light, so your sheet will catch light a little differently than the photos. Photo numbers refer to the image order in this listing.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any professional sports team, league, or brand.
